name: Strata-Sword
description: The Strata-Sword is a hierarchical Chinese-English jailbreak safety benchmark based on quantified reasoning complexity, developed in-house by Alibaba-AAIG |  Strata-Sword  是  Alibaba-AAIG自研的中英文分层越狱攻击安全基准，将“推理复杂度”作为可评估的安全维度，并提出多种中文特有攻击方法，以系统评测不同推理复杂度下LLMs和LRMs的安全边界，从而为提升模型安全性提供新思路。
